LanguageData.LP_Research_FleshShaping.label: fleshshaping
LanguageData.LP_Research_FleshShaping.description: Use twisted meat as a material: flesh incubators, flesh bulwarks, aberrant hide armor, aberrant golem seeds, bioferrite extraction in the infernal forge, and the "Far Realm feast" psychic ritual.\n\nWith Anomaly installed, any one Anomaly flesh research (summon fleshbeasts, ghoul infusion or mutant weapons) must be researched first.
LanguageData.LP_Research_Aberrology.label: aberrant lore
LanguageData.LP_Research_Aberrology.description: Having studied how the Far Realm twists flesh, colonists know where to cut: +10% damage against anomaly entities and aberration enemies (beholders, mind flayers, Far Realm visitors, etc.).\n\nCan't be researched directly: completes automatically once the colony has done "Far Realm dissection" on 500 twisted meat in total at the alchemy table.
